name: securemed-share
description: Innovative Privacy-Preserving Medical Record Sharing System with AES-256-GCM Envelope Encryption, SHA-256 Integrity, Digital Signatures, and Consent-Based Access Control

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend"
scripts.firebase:deploy: npm --prefix frontend run build && firebase deploy
scripts.firebase:deploy:hosting: npm --prefix frontend run build && firebase deploy --only hosting

author: SecureMed Share Team
